Here's the audit of everything stored under `atlas` (117 live claims scanned, no changes made).

**🚩 Real contradiction — needs a decision before handover**
- *"Merging to main deploys atlas to staging automatically."* **vs.** *"Deploys to atlas staging are never automatic: someone runs `bin/ship.sh --staging` by hand."*
These directly disagree on whether staging deploys are CI-triggered or manual. This is exactly the kind of thing that bites a new owner in week one — worth resolving now, not "eventually."

**⚠️ Likely confusion — same term, two meanings**
- *"Feature flags in atlas are an environment variable map and nothing more."* **vs.** *"Feature flags in atlas are additive only, so `cargo check --all-features` has to pass."*
One describes runtime env-var flags, the other Cargo compile-time features. Could be two legitimately different things both called "feature flags," or one is stale. Worth clarifying which is true before you hand it off.

**🔁 Duplicates (same fact, restated) — safe to merge**
- Deploy command, stated 3 ways: *"Project atlas is deployed by running bin/ship.sh from the repository root,"* *"To ship atlas you run the bin/ship.sh script at the top of the repo,"* and *"Deploying atlas means executing bin/ship.sh; the old make deploy target is gone"* (this last one has the only unique detail — the removed `make deploy` target).
- Test runner, stated 2 ways: *"The atlas test suite is run with cargo nextest run, not cargo test"* and *"Tests in atlas are run through cargo nextest run; plain cargo test is not used."*

**🗑️ Stale / session-scoped — probably safe to drop**
- *"The branch under review is spike/consolidate."* — scratch note, 40+ days idle, past its own expiry.
- *"The flaky test being chased this week is pagination_ordering in atlas-api."* — "this week" language from 40+ days ago; almost certainly resolved or superseded by now.

**Not actually problems (flagged by similarity search but topically-adjacent, not duplicate/contradictory)**
- GHCR image push vs. distroless base image
- Postgres 16 storage vs. search index being rebuildable from Postgres
- TypeScript SDK npm package name vs. "SDKs exist for TS and Python only"
- Connection pool size (16) vs. readiness probe waiting on the pool
- Several others chained together by the similarity search rather than genuinely overlapping (Apache 2.0 license, GitHub feature-request discussion, repo access process, no background job queue, etc.) — these just share the `atlas` entity, not content.

Nothing has been changed. Want me to go ahead and merge the duplicates and correct the contradictions (once you tell me which staging-deploy version and feature-flag version is actually true), or would you rather resolve those two questions yourself first?
